task_definition.task_name: Bulk Waveform Download with FDSN Mass Downloader

task_description.overview: Automate large-scale data retrieval across multiple data centers based on geographic and temporal criteria.
steps: Define the geographic domain (latitude/longitude bounds) and time interval for data collection.
Set quality control parameters (e.g., minimum channel availability).
Configure the FDSN mass downloader with target data centers or routing services.
Run the mass downloader to fetch waveforms and station metadata in batch.
Verify and organize downloaded data into a file structure for analysis.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Configure and execute the ObsPy FDSN mass downloader to retrieve seismic waveforms and station metadata for the geographic box [minlatitude, maxlatitude, minlongitude, maxlongitude] from {starttime} to {endtime}. Figure the download waveform to the {waveforms_plot}. Save the download records into a json file {result_data.file_name} with content {result_data.file_content}.
